prOriginalConhecido.nota: Found via gh pr list --search with the title; head 25bf964a is exactly the PR headRefOid (2 commits), merged via merge commit 57972d85 (closes #41242, #41008). Merged code matches the benchmark head.

tps.bug: reauthenticationOfUserWithoutPasskey disables passkeys for the realm, so the hidden webauthn form is guaranteed by isPasskeysEnabled() and the new per-user isConfiguredFor check for users without a passkey is never exercised in UsernamePasswordForm.
tps.evidenciaOpus: reauthenticationOfUserWithoutPasskey (PasskeysUsernamePasswordFormTest.java:279-283) sets setWebAuthnPolicyPasskeysEnabled(FALSE), so UsernamePasswordForm.isConditionalPasskeysEnabled short-circuits on webauthnAuth.isPasskeysEnabled() and never reaches the new per-user isConfiguredFor check. The test's own assertion comment says the form is hidden because 'this user does not have passkey', but it would pass with that check removed; the sibling PasskeysUsernameFormTest variant enables passkeys.
tps.evidenciaAstra: PasskeysUsernamePasswordFormTest.java:283 disables realm passkeys before the absence assertion at line 308, so the test never exercises the user-without-passkey condition. UsernamePasswordForm.java:161-162 short-circuits on isPasskeysEnabled() before checking isConfiguredFor(), meaning removal of the new per-user guard would leave this test passing.
